content:
alex (eng-runtime): quick note: merged microbatch-coalescer + soft-prefetch into canary today. early numbers look solid, posting short summary here.

tere (perf): nice — top-line?

julia (bench): 90m canary snapshot:
```
host = c-phi-3
samples = 52k
token_unit_cost = -15.9%
throughput = +8%
lat_p50 = -10ms
lat_p99 = -45ms
embedding_cost_delta = +2.8%
```

alex (eng-runtime): short context: microbatch-coalescer merges small in-flight microbatches more aggressively when prefix similarity > 0.7. soft-prefetch warms KV entries proactively for sessions with >3 turns. Combined effect reduces small-gen overhead and cuts pathological tails.

sam (sre): deploy-bot shows canary ok. any new alerts?

deploy-bot: rollout/2185000000 -> SUCCESS. warnings=5 (prefetch misses), errors=0.

julia (bench): note: embedding-heavy flows saw slightly worse batching due to prefetch evictions; flagged those tenant routes and excluded in the next ramp.

maya (product): can we draft a short blurb for release notes if this goes prod? customers will love lower latency for chat previews.

alex (eng-runtime): will draft. rollout plan: 10% prod in 2h, 40% in 6h, full in 18h if gates pass. Gate checks (rolling 15m): error_rate <= 0.12%, p99 regression <= +10% baseline, cross-region egress delta <= +2%.

tere (perf): please post dashboard link and baseline query id.

alex (eng-runtime): dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/microbatch/2185000000  query= q_2185000000_coalesce

sam (sre): @oncall please monitor scheduling latency and slot utilization. Pause rollout if slot contention increases >4% sustained for 15m.

maya (product): thx team — include a slide for tomorrow's product sync.

alex (eng-runtime): will update with 6h and 24h snapshots here.
